title: UTA Police / Rider Support
relevance: Direct statement that UTA police are state-certified officers responsible on board UTA vehicles and on UTA property; patrol monitors stations and facilities.

title: 2024 Annual Comprehensive Financial Report
relevance: Primary source for exact named service-area localities, broader principal-county description, and governance/service-area framing.
notes: Narrative section gives the exact named counties/cities/areas; note section gives the broader six-counties-plus-small-Juab description.

title: Utah Code Section 17B-2a-822
relevance: Authorizes a multicounty transit district to employ law enforcement officers for the district.
notes: Primary legal source for transit police designation in the transit-district statute.

title: Utah Code Section 53-13-103
relevance: Classifies transit police officers designated under 17B-2a-822 as law enforcement officers and states general peace-officer authority rules.
notes: Used to verify status as peace officers; not used to justify a statewide production footprint.

title: Utah Code Section 17B-2a-802
relevance: Defines transit facility to include vehicles, stations, depots, loading/unloading zones, parking lots, rail rights-of-way/lines, and reasonable adjacent stop areas.
notes: Key source for the exact custom footprint concept.

title: UTA GTFS Feed
relevance: Official route/stop feed for building the active transit-network geometry.

title: Schedules and Maps
relevance: Official public system maps and route maps for validating network geography and regional spread.

title: Station Addresses
relevance: Official station/location reference for rail and other station properties.
